name: K + Nasdaq-100
description: System J + the pause-time index hold (21 sessions) also triggers when SPY closes 18% or more below its 20-day high (a crash in percentage terms), not only on SPY RSI <= 25. Neighbouring settings: 18% within 15-20 days +1.5 pts over J on every second monthly start, same worst fall; gentler triggers (12-15%, or 30-day windows) deepen the worst fall. Adopted by the owner as a small, low-risk improvement.
